text:
maya: FYI: found flaky ConnectionReset errors in the Android sample when the SDK retry logic is enabled. Repro steps below.

josh: hmm, which endpoint and what retry config? stacktrace?

maya: Streaming chat endpoint, intermittent on emulators and some Pixel devices. Logs show socket closed/reset while retry layer immediately retries -> duplicate request.

maya: log snippet:
```
W/okhttp.OkHttpClient: java.net.SocketException: Connection reset by peer
 at okhttp3.internal.connection.RealConnection.connectSocket(RealConnection.kt:XXX)
 at okhttp3.internal.connection.RealConnection.connect(RealConnection.kt:XXX)
 ...
Caused by: java.net.SocketException: Connection reset by peer
```

alec: Are you using OkHttp default retryOnConnectionFailure=true or our SDK's retry interceptor? On Android those can interact badly for streaming/non-idempotent calls.

maya: SDK uses an internal RetryPolicy + Retrofit call adapter. We also pass OkHttpClient with default settings. When the retry policy triggers, OkHttp may have already consumed the request body or streaming connection — so second attempt fails differently (or duplicates).

sam: Is this only for streaming or regular generate too?

maya: Mostly streaming (server-sent tokens), but saw one generate case with image upload where retry caused 409 duplicate resource creation in our tests.

josh: Quick workaround: disable SDK-level retries for Android default build, or set `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` on OkHttp and let SDK decide. Also consider `callTimeout` vs `readTimeout` differences on Android.

maya: Tried `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` + SDK retry: still saw resets because streaming resumption isn't implemented. For now I patched sample app to set `okHttpClient.dispatcher().maxRequestsPerHost(5)` and `connectionPool(new ConnectionPool(5,5, TimeUnit.MINUTES))` — that reduced occurrences.

alec: Good find. Two action items: 1) expose `disableAutomaticRetries` in our Kotlin SDK builder for Android (so apps can disable internal retries), 2) add a note in Android sample README about OkHttp dispatcher, connection pool, and recommended timeouts.

maya: Also flagged a potential token-refresh race when a 401 comes while a retry is queued — not a full duplicate of the earlier token-refresh thread but related: if refresh happens concurrently, the retried call may use stale credentials.

josh: For token race, the usual fix is single-flight refresh (synchronized token provider) + retry after refresh. Does our SDK already serialize refreshes?

alec: We have a refresh lock in the JVM SDK, but on Android we observed coroutine cancellation + dispatcher switching causing two refresh attempts. I'll add a test harness.

ci-bot: CI build #4821 queued for branch fix/android-retries (tests: sdk-unit, android-emulator).

sam: Can we ship a quick sample update and an opt-in flag this week? We should avoid changing default behavior until we verify.

maya: Plan: push sample patch disabling SDK retries by default on Android + doc + follow-up PR to add builder flag + unit tests for token single-flight. Will open PRs today.

josh: Also add note to migration guide: if you rely on server-side idempotency tokens, explain how retries interact.

alec: I'll create a retro ticket to revisit streaming retry semantics (resume vs full retry). For now, thanks for the repro and the sample patch, @maya. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks — sending PR links shortly.
